d:
Priy vyuar,
Kuchh din pahle do. vikas divyakirti ne saman nagrik sanhita ke mudde se juri jatiltaon ko samjhane ke liye Concept Talk siriz ke antargat ek vidiyo "saman nagrik sanhita" banaya tha jismen is avdharna ke arth, aitihasik vikas, hindu kod bil vivad aadi par vistrit charcha ki gaee thi.
Yah vidiyo usi ka dusra hissa hai jismen nimnalikhit vishyon par vistrit charcha ki gaee hai :
1) bharat ke alpasankhyak samudayon (muslim, eesaee, parsi, yahudi) ke vyaktigat kanun (Personal Laws).
